notes.subject: חמיץ
notes.rationale: Root חמץ 'to be seasoned/leavened': KJV/ASV/JPS 'clean/savoury provender' vs YLT 'fermented provender' — salted-and-winnowed, not leavened, fits the winnowing image.

notes.subject: בליל
notes.rationale: בליל 'mixed feed' occurs only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: ברחת
notes.rationale: The winnowing-shovel ברחת appears only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: sanbugubɔlan / sanbugubɔdaɲɛ
notes.rationale: Verse names the two distinct winnowing implements — shovel (ברחת) and fan/fork (מזרה) — a precise agricultural pair.

translation: Misiw ni barefilenw minnu bɛ dugukolo baara kɛ, bɛna dumuni min farala ɲɔgɔn kan ni kɔgɔ ye dun, min bɛ tosi ni sanbugubɔlan ye ani ni sanbugubɔdaɲɛ ye.
